attempts.rationale: The subject is an admin collaborator on a private repo, so the first GET succeeds. In world A, the owner revokes the subject and permission is evaluated fresh per request, so the second GET returns 404 (private repo, no role). In world A+B, B caches the subject's admin role in the same session during the first GET, so after revocation the cached role still allows the second GET, making the probe fail. Base and B lack the DELETE revoke route, so the revoke step hits Hono's default 404 and the probe reports n/a.
